"""One website in one browser: login, guards, observation and actions.

The model decides what to do; this class only makes each action robust: overlays are closed, cookie walls and
gates handled, expired sessions re-logged, flaky error pages retried, popups folded back into the tab, a tab that
stopped answering replaced by a fresh one, and every action answers with a fresh observation instead of raising.
"""
import asyncio
import html
import inspect
import re
import weakref
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

from playwright.async_api import BrowserContext, Error as PlaywrightError, Frame, Page

from ..log import log

OBSERVE_JS = (Path(__file__).with_name("observe.js")).read_text()
GUARDS_JS = (Path(__file__).with_name("guards.js")).read_text()
MAX_OBSERVATION = 14000
EVAL_TIMEOUT = 12
NAV_TIMEOUT = 15                  # seconds per navigation attempt (pages here load in well under a second)
MAX_TAB_REPLACEMENTS = 8          # per site and run
_STUCK: "weakref.WeakSet[Page]" = weakref.WeakSet()   # tabs whose document stopped answering


async def _eval(target, script: str, arg, timeout: float | None = None):
    """page/frame.evaluate with a time limit: a page stuck in navigation must never block the agent."""
    timeout = timeout or EVAL_TIMEOUT
    try:
        return await asyncio.wait_for(target.evaluate(script, arg), timeout)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        page = target if isinstance(target, Page) else target.page
        if target is page or target is page.main_frame:     # the document itself, not just a slow iframe
            _STUCK.add(page)
        raise PlaywrightError(f"evaluate timed out after {timeout}s")


class Site:
    def __init__(self, site_id: str, url: str, credentials: dict, context: BrowserContext):
        self.site_id, self.url, self.credentials, self.context = site_id, url.rstrip("/"), credentials, context
        self.page: Page | None = None
        self.origin = urlparse(self.url).netloc
        self.logins = 0
        self.seen_urls: set[str] = set()
        self.collections: dict = {}             # read_all_pages results (shared by all missions on this site)
        self.visual_notes: dict[str, list[str]] = {}   # url -> answers read from screenshots
        self._frames: dict[int, Frame] = {}     # frame index of the last observation -> frame (refs stay valid)
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()   # one action at a time per site page
        self.last_good_url = self.url           # the last page whose document answered
        self.replaced_tabs = 0
        self._notice = ""                        # told to the model with the next observation

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
    async def start(self) -> str:
        self.page = self.context.pages[0] if self.context.pages else await self.context.new_page()
        self._wire(self.page)
        await self.goto(self.url)
        return await self.observe()

    def _wire(self, page: Page) -> None:
        page.on("dialog", lambda dialog: asyncio.ensure_future(self._on_dialog(dialog)))
        page.set_default_timeout(8000)
        page.set_default_navigation_timeout(NAV_TIMEOUT * 1000)

    accept_next_dialog = False

    async def _on_dialog(self, dialog) -> None:
        log("native_dialog", site=self.site_id, type=dialog.type, message=dialog.message[:200],
            accept=self.accept_next_dialog)
        try:
            if dialog.type == "beforeunload":   # dismissing it would block every navigation
                await dialog.accept()
            elif self.accept_next_dialog:
                self.accept_next_dialog = False
                await dialog.accept()
            else:
                await dialog.dismiss()
        except PlaywrightError:
            pass

    async def _ensure_page(self) -> Page:
        if self.page is None or self.page.is_closed():
            self.page = await self.context.new_page()
            self._wire(self.page)
            await self.goto(self.url)
        elif self.page in _STUCK and self.replaced_tabs < MAX_TAB_REPLACEMENTS:
            await self._replace_stuck_tab()
        return self.page

    async def _replace_stuck_tab(self) -> None:
        """The tab stopped answering (a navigation that never completes, a frozen script). Every later action on it
        would time out too, so continue in a fresh tab at the last page that worked, and tell the model."""
        stuck_url = self.page.url
        self.replaced_tabs += 1
        log("tab_replaced", site=self.site_id, stuck_url=_short(stuck_url), resume=_short(self.last_good_url))
        self._notice = (f"NOTE: the tab stopped responding at {stuck_url} and was replaced by a fresh one at "
                        f"{self.last_good_url}. That page may be temporarily broken: retry it once or take another route.")
        await self._fresh_page()
        try:                                     # one attempt: an outage must not turn into minutes of retries
            await self.page.goto(self.last_good_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=NAV_TIMEOUT * 1000)
        except PlaywrightError as error:
            log("goto_error", site=self.site_id, url=_short(self.last_good_url), error=str(error)[:200])
        await self.settle()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- navigation + guards
    async def _fresh_page(self) -> None:
        """Continue in a new tab when the current one is stuck (the old one is left alone, not closed)."""
        log("fresh_tab", site=self.site_id)
        self.page = await self.context.new_page()
        self._wire(self.page)

    async def goto(self, url: str, frame: Frame | None = None) -> bool:
        """Navigate, retrying flaky errors (a fresh tab after a failed attempt). False if the page never loaded: the
        tab is then marked stuck and continues at the last page that worked on the next step."""
        target, failed = frame or self.page, False
        for attempt in range(3):
            if attempt == 1 and frame is None:      # a failed navigation may leave the tab stuck: use a fresh one
                await self._fresh_page()
                target = self.page
            try:
                response = await target.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=NAV_TIMEOUT * 1000)
                failed = False
                if response is not None and response.status >= 500:
                    log("http_error", site=self.site_id, status=response.status, url=_short(url))
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.7 * (attempt + 1))
                    continue
                break
            except PlaywrightError as error:
                failed = True
                log("goto_error", site=self.site_id, url=_short(url), error=str(error)[:200])
                await asyncio.sleep(0.7 * (attempt + 1))
        if failed and frame is None and self.page:
            _STUCK.add(self.page)
        await self.settle()
        return not failed

    async def settle(self, rounds: int = 6) -> None:
        """Run the guards until the page is usable: error retry, login, cookie consent, overlays, gates."""
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(self._settle(rounds), timeout=45)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            log("settle_timeout", site=self.site_id, url=_short(self.page.url if self.page else ""))
            if self.page:
                _STUCK.add(self.page)            # the guards could not get an answer from this tab

    async def _settle(self, rounds: int) -> None:
        page = await self._ensure_page()
        for _ in range(rounds):
            try:
                await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=10000)
            except PlaywrightError:
                pass
            state = await self._guard_state()
            if state.get("error_page"):
                log("guard_error_page", site=self.site_id, url=_short(page.url))
                await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
                retry = state.get("retry_href")
                await self._safe_goto(urljoin(page.url, retry) if retry else page.url)
                continue
            if state.get("login"):
                if await self._login():
                    continue
                return
            if state.get("consent"):
                log("guard_consent", site=self.site_id)
                await self._click_js("consent")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
                continue
            closed = await self._run_guards_everywhere("close_overlays")
            unlocked = await self._run_guards_everywhere("unlock_gates")
            if closed or unlocked:
                log("guard_overlays", site=self.site_id, closed=closed, unlocked=unlocked)
            return

    async def _safe_goto(self, url: str) -> None:
        try:
            await self.page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        except PlaywrightError:
            pass

    async def _guard_state(self) -> dict:
        try:
            return await _eval(self.page, GUARDS_JS, {"op": "state"}) or {}
        except PlaywrightError:
            return {}

    async def _click_js(self, op: str) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await _eval(self.page, GUARDS_JS, {"op": op}))
        except PlaywrightError:
            return False

    async def _run_guards_everywhere(self, op: str) -> int:
        count = 0
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                count += int(await _eval(frame, GUARDS_JS, {"op": op}) or 0)
            except PlaywrightError:
                pass
        return count

    async def _login(self) -> bool:
        if self.logins >= 6:
            log("login_giving_up", site=self.site_id)
            return False
        self.logins += 1
        page = self.page
        log("guard_login", site=self.site_id, attempt=self.logins)
        try:
            password = page.locator("input[type=password]:visible").first
            form = password.locator("xpath=ancestor::form[1]")
            scope = form if await form.count() else page
            user = scope.locator("input:visible:not([type=password]):not([type=hidden]):not([type=checkbox])"
                                 ":not([type=submit]):not([type=button])").first
            await user.fill(self.credentials["username"])
            await password.fill(self.credentials["password"])
            submit = scope.locator("button[type=submit]:visible, input[type=submit]:visible, button:visible").first
            if await submit.count():
                await submit.click()
            else:
                await password.press("Enter")
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
            return True
        except PlaywrightError as error:
            log("login_error", site=self.site_id, error=str(error)[:200])
            return False

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- observation
    async def observe(self, limit: int = MAX_OBSERVATION, _retried: bool = False) -> str:
        page = await self._ensure_page()
        parts = [f"URL: {page.url}"]
        self._frames = {}
        for index, frame in enumerate(page.frames):
            if frame.is_detached():
                continue
            self._frames[index] = frame
            try:
                result = await _eval(frame, OBSERVE_JS, {"prefix": "e" if index == 0 else f"f{index}e"})
            except PlaywrightError as error:
                parts.append(f"=== frame {index} {frame.url}: unreadable ({str(error)[:80]})")
                continue
            if index and not result["text"].strip():
                continue
            if index:
                parts.append(f"=== frame {index}: {frame.url} ===")
            else:
                parts.append(f"TITLE: {result['title']}")
                if urlparse(page.url).netloc == self.origin:
                    self.last_good_url = page.url
            parts.append(result["text"])
            for match in re.finditer(r"-> (\S+)|src=(\S+?)[\] ]", result["text"]):
                self.seen_urls.add(urljoin(frame.url, html.unescape(match.group(1) or match.group(2))))
        if page in _STUCK and not _retried and self.replaced_tabs < MAX_TAB_REPLACEMENTS:
            return await self.observe(limit, _retried=True)     # replaced now instead of showing a dead tab
        if self._notice:
            parts.insert(0, self._notice)
            self._notice = ""
        text = "\n".join(parts)
        if len(text) > limit:
            text = text[:limit] + f"\n[… observation cut at {limit} chars; use read_all_pages/extract for full text]"
        return text

    async def full_text(self, follow_iframes: bool = True) -> str:
        """The whole page. Iframes that show nothing (e.g. an empty srcdoc hiding a real src) are loaded from their
        src in a helper tab, one level deep."""
        text = await self.observe(limit=200000)
        if not follow_iframes:
            return text
        shown = set(re.findall(r"^=== frame \d+: (\S+) ===$", text, re.M))   # frames that had content
        for src in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"\[iframe [^\]]*?src=(\S+?)(?: \(srcdoc\))?\]", text)):
            url = urljoin(self.page.url, src)
            if not src or url in shown or urlparse(url).netloc != self.origin:
                continue
            extra = await self.read_url(url, follow_iframes=False)
            text += f"\n=== content of iframe source {url} ===\n{extra}"
        notes = self.visual_notes.get(self.page.url.split("#")[0])
        if notes:
            text += "\n=== read from a screenshot of this page (visual) ===\n" + "\n".join(notes)
        return text

    def note_visual(self, url: str, note: str) -> None:
        self.visual_notes.setdefault(url.split("#")[0], []).append(note)

    def _locate(self, ref: str):
        page = self.page
        match = re.fullmatch(r"f(\d+)e\d+", ref)
        frame = page.main_frame
        if match:
            index = int(match.group(1))
            frame = self._frames.get(index)
            if frame is None or frame.is_detached():
                frame = page.frames[index] if index < len(page.frames) else page.main_frame
        return frame, frame.locator(f'[data-agent-ref="{ref}"]')

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- actions (never raise)
    async def act(self, name: str, args: dict) -> str:
        async with self.lock:
            try:
                await self._ensure_page()
                # Delayed popups (surveys, notices) may have opened since the last observation.
                await self._run_guards_everywhere("close_overlays")
                method = getattr(self, f"_do_{name}")
                accepted = inspect.signature(method).parameters
                message = await asyncio.wait_for(
                    method(**{k: v for k, v in args.items() if k in accepted and v not in (None, "")}), timeout=60)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                message = f"ERROR: {name} did not finish within 60 s"
                _STUCK.add(self.page)                # replaced on the next action or observation
            except (PlaywrightError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError) as error:
                message = f"ERROR: {name} failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:300]}"
            await self.settle()
            return message

    async def _element(self, ref: str):
        ref = re.sub(r"[^\w]", "", str(ref))          # models sometimes send '"e9"' or '[e9]'
        frame, locator = self._locate(ref)
        if not await locator.count():
            raise ValueError(f"ref {ref} is not on the current page (refs change after every action)")
        return frame, locator.first

    async def _do_click(self, ref: str) -> str:
        frame, el = await self._element(ref)
        tag = await el.evaluate("e => e.tagName")
        href = await el.get_attribute("href") if tag == "A" else None
        if href and not href.startswith(("#", "javascript:")):
            if await self.goto(urljoin(frame.url, href), frame=None if frame == self.page.main_frame else frame):
                return f"opened {href}"
            return f"ERROR: {href} did not load (the website did not answer in time); retry once or take another route"
        pages_before = set(self.context.pages)
        try:
            await el.click(timeout=5000)
        except PlaywrightError:
            await self._run_guards_everywhere("close_overlays")
            try:
                await el.click(timeout=4000)
            except PlaywrightError:
                await el.dispatch_event("click")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        folded = await self._fold_popups(pages_before)
        return "clicked" + (f"; {folded}" if folded else "")

    async def _fold_popups(self, pages_before: set) -> str:
        """A new window (window.open, target=_blank) is loaded in our tab instead, so the model keeps one view."""
        for popup in set(self.context.pages) - pages_before:
            try:
                await popup.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=8000)
                url = popup.url
                await popup.close()
                if url and url != "about:blank":
                    await self.goto(url)
                    return f"a popup window opened {url} and was loaded here instead"
            except PlaywrightError:
                pass
        return ""

    async def _ready(self, el) -> str | None:
        """Make a form control usable (open collapsed <details> around it); explain why it is not."""
        await el.evaluate("e => { for (let d = e.closest('details'); d; d = d.parentElement && d.parentElement.closest('details')) d.open = true; }")
        if await el.is_disabled():
            return ("ERROR: this field is disabled right now. Usually the previous choice must be applied first "
                    "(e.g. an 'apply/übernehmen' button), or a gate must be unlocked.")
        return None

    async def _do_type(self, ref: str, text: str, submit: bool = False) -> str:
        _, el = await self._element(ref)
        if problem := await self._ready(el):
            return problem
        await el.fill(str(text), timeout=4000)
        value = await el.input_value()
        if submit:
            await el.press("Enter")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        return f"typed; field now contains {value!r}" + (" and pressed Enter" if submit else "")

    async def _do_select(self, ref: str, option: str, then_click: str | None = None) -> str:
        result = await self._select(ref, option, hint=not then_click)
        return result + ("" if result.startswith("ERROR") else await self._then_click(then_click))

    async def _select(self, ref: str, option: str, hint: bool = False) -> str:
        _, el = await self._element(ref)
        if problem := await self._ready(el):
            return problem
        options = await el.evaluate("e => [...e.options].map(o => [o.value, o.textContent.trim()])")
        wanted = " ".join(str(option).split()).casefold()
        value = next((v for v, label in options if label.casefold() == wanted or v.casefold() == wanted), None)
        if value is None:
            hits = [v for v, label in options if wanted and wanted in label.casefold()]
            value = hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None
        if value is None:
            return f"ERROR: no option {option!r}. Options: " + " | ".join(label for _, label in options)
        await el.select_option(value=value, timeout=4000)
        hint = hint and await el.evaluate("""e => { const f = e.form || e.closest('form') || document;
            return [...f.querySelectorAll('select:disabled, input:disabled')].length; }""")
        return f"selected {value!r}" + (" (other fields of this form are still disabled: apply the choice with the "
                                        "form's apply/update button, e.g. via then_click)" if hint else "")

    async def _do_check(self, ref: str, checked: bool = True) -> str:
        _, el = await self._element(ref)
        if problem := await self._ready(el):
            return problem
        kind = await el.evaluate("e => e.type")
        if kind not in ("checkbox", "radio"):
            return f"ERROR: {ref} is not a checkbox/radio (it is {kind}); click it instead"
        await el.set_checked(bool(checked), force=True, timeout=4000)
        return f"{'checked' if checked else 'unchecked'}"

    async def _then_click(self, ref: str | None) -> str:
        if not ref:
            return ""
        return "; then " + await self._do_click(str(ref))

    async def _do_fill_fields(self, fields: list, then_click: str | None = None) -> str:
        """Several form fields in one step: text inputs, selects and checkboxes, each verified."""
        results = []
        for field in fields or []:
            ref, value = str(field.get("ref")), field.get("value")
            try:
                _, el = await self._element(ref)
                tag, kind = await el.evaluate("e => [e.tagName, e.type]")
                if tag == "SELECT":
                    results.append(f"{ref}: " + await self._select(ref, str(value)))
                elif kind in ("checkbox", "radio"):
                    on = str(value).lower() not in ("false", "0", "no", "nein", "")
                    results.append(f"{ref}: " + await self._do_check(ref, on))
                else:
                    results.append(f"{ref}: " + await self._do_type(ref, str(value)))
            except (PlaywrightError, ValueError) as error:
                results.append(f"{ref}: ERROR {str(error).splitlines()[0][:150]}")
        return "; ".join(results) + await self._then_click(then_click)

    async def _do_set_slider(self, ref: str, value: str = "max") -> str:
        _, el = await self._element(ref)
        if str(value) == "max":
            value = await el.get_attribute("max") or "100"
        await el.fill(str(value))
        return f"slider set to {value}"

    async def _do_back(self) -> str:
        await self.page.go_back(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        return "went back"

    async def _do_open_url(self, url: str) -> str:
        url = self.absolute(url)
        if urlparse(url).netloc != self.origin:
            return "ERROR: only URLs of this website can be opened"
        if not self.was_seen(url):
            return "ERROR: this address was not offered on any page you saw; navigate via the links shown instead"
        if await self.goto(url):
            return f"opened {url}"
        return f"ERROR: {url} did not load (the website did not answer in time); retry once or take another route"

    async def _do_scroll(self, ref: str | None = None, direction: str = "down", amount: int = 600) -> str:
        delta = abs(int(amount or 600)) * (-1 if direction == "up" else 1)
        if ref:
            frame, el = await self._element(ref)
            if await el.evaluate("e => e.tagName") in ("IFRAME", "FRAME"):
                inner = await el.content_frame()
                if inner:
                    await inner.evaluate(f"window.scrollBy(0, {delta})")
                    return f"scrolled inside the frame by {delta}px"
            moved = await el.evaluate(f"e => {{ const before = e.scrollTop; e.scrollBy(0, {delta}); return e.scrollTop - before; }}")
            if not moved:
                await el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            return f"scrolled the element by {moved}px" if moved else "scrolled the element into view"
        await self.page.mouse.wheel(0, delta)
        return f"scrolled the page by {delta}px"

    async def _do_hover(self, ref: str) -> str:
        _, el = await self._element(ref)
        await el.hover(timeout=4000)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        return "hovering (menus/tooltips that open on hover are now shown)"

    async def _do_press_key(self, key: str, ref: str | None = None) -> str:
        pages_before = set(self.context.pages)
        if ref:
            _, el = await self._element(ref)
            await el.press(str(key), timeout=4000)
        else:
            await self.page.keyboard.press(str(key))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
        folded = await self._fold_popups(pages_before)
        return f"pressed {key}" + (f"; {folded}" if folded else "")

    async def _do_wait_for(self, condition: str, ref: str | None = None, timeout_s: float = 6) -> str:
        """Short, bounded wait for an observable condition (never a blind sleep)."""
        condition = str(condition or "change").strip()
        limit = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + max(0.5, min(float(timeout_s or 6), 10))
        before = await _eval(self.page, "() => document.body ? document.body.innerText.length : 0", None)
        while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < limit:
            try:
                if condition in ("enabled", "visible") and ref:
                    _, el = await self._element(ref)
                    if (condition == "enabled" and await el.is_enabled()) or (condition == "visible" and await el.is_visible()):
                        return f"condition '{condition}' met"
                elif condition.startswith("text:"):
                    words = condition[5:].strip().lower()
                    if words and words in (await _eval(self.page, "() => document.body.innerText", None)).lower():
                        return f"text '{words}' appeared"
                elif condition == "change":
                    now = await _eval(self.page, "() => document.body ? document.body.innerText.length : 0", None)
                    if now != before:
                        return "the page changed"
            except (PlaywrightError, ValueError):
                pass
            await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        return f"condition '{condition}' not met within the time limit"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers for model-selected content
    async def spawn(self) -> "Site":
        """Another tab of this website in the same browser context (shares the login session)."""
        twin = Site(self.site_id, self.url, self.credentials, self.context)
        twin.seen_urls, twin.collections, twin.visual_notes = self.seen_urls, self.collections, self.visual_notes
        twin.page = await self.context.new_page()
        twin._wire(twin.page)
        await twin.goto(self.url)
        return twin

    def absolute(self, url: str) -> str:
        return urljoin(self.page.url, html.unescape(str(url).strip()))

    def was_seen(self, url: str) -> bool:
        """Only addresses that appeared as links/frames on observed pages may be opened directly: the model picks
        from what the website offers instead of guessing addresses."""
        key = url.split("#")[0].rstrip("/")
        return key == self.url or any(seen.split("#")[0].rstrip("/") == key for seen in self.seen_urls)

    async def read_url(self, url: str, follow_iframes: bool = True) -> str:
        """Open a model-selected URL of this site in a helper tab and return its full serialized text."""
        url = self.absolute(url)
        if urlparse(url).netloc != self.origin:
            return "ERROR: only URLs of this website can be read"
        helper = Site(self.site_id, self.url, self.credentials, self.context)
        helper.logins, helper.seen_urls = self.logins, self.seen_urls
        helper.page = await self.context.new_page()
        helper._wire(helper.page)
        try:
            await helper.goto(url)
            if helper.page.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/") and "login" not in url:
                await helper.goto(url)       # after a re-login the site may have dropped the target
            return await helper.full_text(follow_iframes)
        finally:
            await helper.page.close()

    async def screenshot(self, ref: str | None = None) -> bytes:
        """JPEG of an element (if it has a size) or of the viewport."""
        if ref:
            try:
                _, el = await self._element(ref)
                box = await el.bounding_box()
                if box and box["width"] > 4 and box["height"] > 4:
                    return await el.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=70, timeout=5000)
            except (PlaywrightError, ValueError):
                pass
        return await self.page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=60)


def _short(url: str) -> str:
    return url[:160]

1	"""From extracted evidence to the bid: deterministic application of the brief's rules (docs/04-business-rules.md).
2	
3	Input is the blackboard (raw extractions with source URLs) and the task context. Output is the answer (schema of the
4	run) plus a trace of every decision and the positions that could not be completed (to be skipped in the form).
5	Nothing here raises on missing data: it degrades to the best possible answer and says why in the trace.
6	"""
7	from collections import defaultdict
8	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
9	from datetime import datetime
10	from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal as D
11	from math import ceil
12	
13	from .parse import cert, clean, day, integer, money_locale, norm_id, number, revision_is_current, same_text, when
14	
15	CENT = D("0.01")
16	
17	
18	def r2(value: D) -> D:
19	    return value.quantize(CENT, ROUND_HALF_UP)
20	
21	
22	@dataclass
23	class Context:
24	    tender_reference: str
25	    scenario: datetime
26	    director_localpart: str | None = None
27	    authorized: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)      # topic -> sender local part
28	    mailbox_domain: str | None = None
29	    searched_groups: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)        # catalogue groups whose ERP search is complete
30	
31	
32	@dataclass
33	class Result:
34	    answer: dict
35	    trace: list[str]
36	    skipped: list[str]                # positions we could not complete
37	    breakdown: dict                   # per position, unrounded components (for logs)
38	
39	
40	def largest_remainder(total: D, weights: dict[str, D]) -> dict[str, D]:
41	    """Distribute `total` in cents proportionally; floor first, remaining cents to the largest remainders,
42	    ties by ascending position id."""
43	    weights = {k: w for k, w in weights.items() if w > 0}
44	    if not weights or total <= 0:
45	        return {k: D(0) for k in weights}
46	    cents = int((total * 100).to_integral_value(ROUND_HALF_UP))
47	    wsum = sum(weights.values())
48	    raw = {k: D(cents) * w / wsum for k, w in weights.items()}
49	    base = {k: int(v.to_integral_value(ROUND_FLOOR)) for k, v in raw.items()}
50	    for k in sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(raw[k] - base[k]), k))[: cents - sum(base.values())]:
51	        base[k] += 1
52	    return {k: D(c) / 100 for k, c in base.items()}
53	
54	
55	def marginal_bonus(total: D, bands: list[dict]) -> D:
56	    credit = D(0)
57	    for band in bands:
58	        low = number(band.get("from_eur")) or D(0)
59	        high = number(band.get("to_eur"))
60	        rate = (number(band.get("rate_percent")) or D(0)) / 100
61	        top = total if high is None else min(total, high)
62	        if top > low:
63	            credit += (top - low) * rate
64	    return r2(credit)
65	
66	
67	def build(ctx: Context, bb: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> Result:
68	    trace: list[str] = []
69	    note = trace.append
70	    T = ctx.scenario
71	    ref_id = norm_id(ctx.tender_reference)
72	
73	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- positions & quantities
74	    positions: dict[str, dict] = {}
75	    for item in bb.get("positions", []):
76	        for p in item["data"].get("positions") or []:
77	            pid = clean(p.get("position"))
78	            if pid:
79	                positions.setdefault(pid, {}).update({k: v for k, v in p.items() if v not in (None, "")})
80	    note(f"positions: {list(positions)}")
81	
82	    entries: dict[str, dict] = {}
83	    for item in bb.get("clarifications", []):
84	        for e in item["data"].get("entries") or []:
85	            if e.get("number"):
86	                entries[norm_id(e["number"])] = e
87	    withdrawn = {norm_id(f.get("withdrawn_number")) for e in entries.values() for f in e.get("facts") or []
88	                 if f.get("type") == "withdrawal" and f.get("withdrawn_number")}
89	    if withdrawn:
90	        note(f"withdrawn Q&A answers: {sorted(withdrawn)}")
91	    facts = []                                                   # (datetime, number, fact)
92	    for key, e in entries.items():
93	        at = when(e.get("datetime_utc"))
94	        if key in withdrawn:
95	            continue
96	        if at is not None and at > T:
97	            note(f"Q&A {key} is dated after the scenario date; ignored")
98	            continue
99	        for f in e.get("facts") or []:
100	            facts.append((at or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=T.tzinfo), integer(key) or 0, f))
101	    facts.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
102	
103	    def latest(kind: str, pid: str | None = None, pred=lambda f: True) -> dict | None:
104	        found = None
105	        for _, _, f in facts:
106	            if f.get("type") == kind and (pid is None or same_text(f.get("position"), pid)) and pred(f):
107	                found = f
108	        return found
109	
110	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- specification
111	    revisions = [r for item in bb.get("spec_revisions", []) for r in item["data"].get("revisions") or []]
112	    current = [r for r in revisions if revision_is_current(r)]
113	    current_rev = norm_id(current[-1]["revision"]) if current else None
114	    if len({norm_id(r.get("revision")) for r in current}) > 1:
115	        note(f"WARNING several revisions look current: {[r.get('revision') for r in current]}; using {current_rev}")
116	    note(f"current specification revision: {current_rev}")
117	    requirements: dict[str, dict] = {}
118	    for item in bb.get("requirements", []):
119	        rev = norm_id(item["data"].get("revision"))
120	        if current_rev and rev and rev != current_rev:
121	            note(f"ignoring requirements of revision {rev} (not current)")
122	            continue
123	        for r in item["data"].get("requirements") or []:
124	            if r.get("ref"):
125	                requirements[norm_id(r["ref"])] = {**r, "revision": rev or current_rev}
126	
127	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- mails (authority and time)
128	    domain = ctx.mailbox_domain
129	    for item in bb.get("mail_list", []):
130	        address = clean(item["data"].get("mailbox_address"))
131	        if "@" in address:
132	            domain = address.split("@", 1)[1].lower()
133	    mails = []
134	    for item in bb.get("mail_message", []):
135	        m = item["data"]
136	        at = when(m.get("datetime_utc"))
137	        if m.get("is_draft_or_preview"):
138	            continue
139	        if norm_id(m.get("reference")) != ref_id:
140	            continue
141	        if at is None or at > T:
142	            note(f"mail '{clean(m.get('subject'))}' dated {at} is after the scenario date or undated; ignored")
143	            continue
144	        mails.append((at, m))
145	    mails.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
146	
147	    def authorized(topic: str, sender: str) -> bool:
148	        local = (ctx.director_localpart if topic == "discount" else ctx.authorized.get(topic)) or ""
149	        sender = clean(sender).lower()
150	        if "<" in sender:
151	            sender = sender.split("<")[-1].rstrip(">")
152	        if local and not sender.startswith(local.lower() + "@"):
153	            return False
154	        if domain and not sender.endswith("@" + domain):
155	            return False
156	        return True
157	
158	    def topic_records(topic: str) -> list[dict]:
159	        return [m for _, m in mails if m.get("topic") == topic and authorized(topic, m.get("sender", ""))]
160	
161	    def keyed(topic: str, field_name: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
162	        out: dict[str, dict] = {}
163	        for m in topic_records(topic):                    # ascending by date: newer records replace older ones
164	            for k, v in ((m.get("data") or {}).get(field_name) or {}).items():
165	                out[norm_id(k)] = v
166	        return out
167	
168	    clauses = keyed("clause_rules", "groups")
169	    reserves = keyed("tech_release", "entries")
170	    tariffs = keyed("packaging", "tariffs")
171	    commitments = keyed("delivery", "commitments")
172	    fx_rates = keyed("fx", "rates")
173	    pools = keyed("setup_pool", "pools")
174	    bonus_plans = keyed("project_bonus", "plans")
175	    indices = keyed("metal_index", "indices")
176	    note(f"mail keys: clauses={list(clauses)} reserves={list(reserves)} tariffs={list(tariffs)} "
177	         f"commitments={list(commitments)} fx={list(fx_rates)} pools={list(pools)} bonus={list(bonus_plans)} "
178	         f"indices={list(indices)} domain={domain}")
179	
180	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials
181	    materials: dict[str, dict] = {}
182	    for item in bb.get("materials", []):
183	        for m in item["data"].get("materials") or []:
184	            num = norm_id(m.get("material_number"))
185	            if not num:
186	                continue
187	            target = materials.setdefault(num, {"material_number": clean(m["material_number"]), "conditions": []})
188	            for k, v in m.items():
189	                if k == "conditions":
190	                    for c in v or []:
191	                        if c.get("scales") and c not in target["conditions"]:
192	                            target["conditions"].append(c)
193	                elif v not in (None, "", []):
194	                    target[k] = v
195	
196	    def matches(mat: dict, req: dict, stroke: D | None) -> bool:
197	        """Exact match. stroke=None means 'nominal stroke unknown' (e.g. end reserve not found): stroke is then not
198	        compared here and the caller picks among the remaining candidates."""
199	        checks = [(number(mat.get("bore_mm")), number(req.get("bore_mm"))),
200	                  (number(mat.get("pressure_bar")), number(req.get("pressure_bar")))]
201	        if stroke is not None:
202	            checks.append((number(mat.get("stroke_mm")), stroke))
203	        if any(a is None or b is None or a != b for a, b in checks):
204	            return False
205	        if not same_text(mat.get("mounting"), req.get("mounting")):
206	            return False
207	        return cert(mat.get("certification")) == cert(req.get("certification"))
208	
209	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- per position
210	    resolved: dict[str, dict] = {}
211	    skipped: list[str] = []
212	    no_material: list[str] = []
213	    for pid, p in positions.items():
214	        qty, unit = number(p.get("quantity")), clean(p.get("unit"))
215	        change = latest("quantity_change", pid)
216	        if change:
217	            qty, unit = number(change.get("quantity")), clean(change.get("unit")) or unit
218	            note(f"{pid}: quantity from Q&A -> {qty} {unit}")
219	        req = requirements.get(norm_id(p.get("requirement_ref")))
220	        if req is None:
221	            note(f"{pid}: requirement {p.get('requirement_ref')} not found")
222	            skipped.append(pid)
223	            continue
224	        if unit and not unit.lower().startswith(("st", "stk", "stück", "pc", "piece")):
225	            per_set = integer(req.get("pieces_per_set"))
226	            if per_set:
227	                qty = qty * per_set
228	                note(f"{pid}: {unit} -> pieces x{per_set} = {qty}")
229	            else:
230	                note(f"{pid}: unit {unit} without pieces-per-set conversion")
231	        q = int(qty) if qty is not None else 0
232	        attrs = dict(req)
233	        for attribute in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification"):
234	            amendment = latest("tech_amendment", None, lambda f, a=attribute: norm_id(f.get("revision")) == norm_id(req["revision"])
235	                               and norm_id(f.get("requirement")) == norm_id(req["ref"]) and f.get("attribute") == a)
236	            if amendment:
237	                field_name = {"bore": "bore_mm", "stroke": "stroke_mm", "pressure": "pressure_bar"}.get(attribute, attribute)
238	                attrs[field_name] = amendment.get("value")
239	                note(f"{pid}: amendment {attribute} = {amendment.get('value')}")
240	        stroke = number(attrs.get("stroke_mm"))
241	        usable_floor = None
242	        if attrs.get("usable_stroke") and stroke is not None:
243	            key = norm_id(attrs.get("end_reserve_key"))
244	            entry = reserves.get(key)
245	            if entry and (not entry.get("revision") or norm_id(entry["revision"]) == norm_id(req["revision"])):
246	                reserve = number(entry.get("reserve_mm_per_end")) or D(0)
247	                stroke = stroke + 2 * reserve
248	                note(f"{pid}: usable stroke + 2x{reserve} ({key}) = nominal {stroke}")
249	            else:
250	                note(f"{pid}: WARNING end reserve {key} for revision {req['revision']} not found; nominal stroke unknown")
251	                usable_floor, stroke = stroke, None
252	        group = norm_id(attrs.get("catalog_group"))
253	        candidates = [m for m in materials.values() if not group or not m.get("catalog_group") or norm_id(m.get("catalog_group")) == group]
254	        fitting = [m for m in candidates if matches(m, attrs, stroke)]
255	        if stroke is None and usable_floor is not None:
256	            # unknown reserve: the nominal stroke must exceed the usable one; prefer the closest such material
257	            longer = [m for m in fitting if (number(m.get("stroke_mm")) or D(0)) > usable_floor]
258	            ranked = sorted(longer or fitting, key=lambda m: (m.get("status_meaning") != "active", number(m.get("stroke_mm")) or D(0)))
259	            fitting = ranked[:1]
260	            uncertain = True
261	        else:
262	            uncertain = False
263	        active = [m for m in fitting if m.get("status_meaning") == "active"]
264	        note(f"{pid}: group {group} candidates={[m['material_number'] for m in candidates]} "
265	             f"fitting={[m['material_number'] for m in fitting]} active={[m['material_number'] for m in active]}")
266	        if not active:
267	            if fitting and all(m.get("status_meaning") is None for m in fitting):
268	                active = fitting
269	                note(f"{pid}: UNCERTAIN status unknown for {[m['material_number'] for m in fitting]}; best guess, not proof")
270	            elif candidates and not uncertain and group and group in ctx.searched_groups:
271	                no_material.append(pid)      # proven: the complete search found no active matching material
272	                continue
273	            elif candidates:
274	                note(f"{pid}: no fitting active material among {[m['material_number'] for m in candidates]}, but the "
275	                     f"search of group {group} is not proven complete: position skipped, no no_bid")
276	                skipped.append(pid)
277	                continue
278	            else:
279	                skipped.append(pid)
280	                continue
281	        material = sorted(active, key=lambda m: (not m.get("conditions"), m["material_number"]))[0]
282	        resolved[pid] = {"q": q, "material": material, "req": attrs}
283	
284	    # A position without any active matching material (and evidence that we looked) means no bid.
285	    if no_material:
286	        note(f"no active matching material for {no_material}: no_bid")
287	        answer = {"tender_reference": ctx.tender_reference, "decision": "no_bid", "currency": "EUR",
288	                  "discount_percent": 0, "positions": [], "total_net": 0}
289	        return Result(answer, trace, [], {})
290	
291	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- prices
292	    def condition_price(m: dict, q: int, pid: str) -> D | None:
293	        valid = []
294	        for c in m.get("conditions") or []:
295	            start, end = when(c.get("valid_from")), when(c.get("valid_to"))
296	            if start and start > T and day(c.get("valid_from")) != T.date():
297	                continue
298	            if end and end < T and day(c.get("valid_to")) != T.date():
299	                continue
300	            valid.append(c)
301	        if not valid:
302	            note(f"{pid}: no price condition valid on {T.date()}")
303	            return None
304	        if len(valid) > 1:   # the latest record wins (then the narrower window), never the extraction order
305	            far = datetime.max.replace(tzinfo=T.tzinfo)
306	            valid.sort(key=lambda c: (when(c.get("valid_from")) or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=T.tzinfo),
307	                                      -((when(c.get("valid_to")) or far) - T).total_seconds()))
308	            note(f"{pid}: WARNING {len(valid)} price conditions valid on {T.date()}; using the one from "
309	                 f"{valid[-1].get('valid_from')}")
310	        c = valid[-1]
311	        fmt = c.get("number_format")
312	        if not fmt:   # an untagged table is read in its own consistent format, never number by number
313	            fmt = money_locale([s.get("price") for s in c.get("scales") or []])
314	            if fmt:
315	                note(f"{pid}: number format inferred: {fmt} (prices {[s.get('price') for s in c.get('scales') or []]})")
316	        scales = sorted(((number(s.get("from_qty"), fmt), number(s.get("price"), fmt)) for s in c.get("scales") or []),
317	                        key=lambda s: s[0] or 0)
318	        usable = [s for s in scales if s[0] is not None and s[1] is not None and s[0] <= q] or scales[:1]
319	        if not usable:
320	            return None
321	        price = usable[-1][1] / (number(c.get("price_unit_qty"), fmt) or D(1))
322	        currency = clean(c.get("currency")).upper() or "EUR"
323	        if currency != "EUR":
324	            rate = fx_rates.get(norm_id(c.get("fx_key")))
325	            eur = number((rate or {}).get("eur_per_unit"))
326	            if eur is None:
327	                note(f"{pid}: no FX rate for {c.get('fx_key')} ({currency}); price left in {currency}")
328	                eur = D(1)
329	            price *= eur
330	        base = r2(price)
331	        note(f"{pid}: scale from {usable[-1][0]} price {usable[-1][1]} / unit {c.get('price_unit_qty')} {currency} -> base {base} EUR")
332	        return base
333	
334	    for pid, r in resolved.items():
335	        r["base"] = condition_price(r["material"], r["q"], pid)
336	
337	    # discount (order level, possibly conditional)
338	    approvals = [m for m in topic_records("discount") if (m.get("data") or {}).get("is_approval")]
339	    discount = D(0)
340	    if approvals:
341	        data = approvals[-1]["data"]
342	        discount = number(data.get("percent")) or D(0)
343	        threshold = number(data.get("min_order_value_eur"))
344	        if threshold is not None:
345	            order_value = r2(sum((r["q"] * r["base"] for r in resolved.values() if r["base"] is not None), D(0)))
346	            if order_value < threshold:
347	                note(f"discount condition failed: {order_value} < {threshold}")
348	                discount = D(0)
349	            else:
350	                note(f"discount condition met: {order_value} >= {threshold}")
351	        note(f"discount {discount} % from '{clean(approvals[-1].get('subject'))}'")
352	    else:
353	        note("no discount approval found: 0 %")
354	    d = discount / 100
355	
356	    # setup pools and project bonus
357	    pool_members: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
358	    bonus_members: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
359	    assignments = {}
360	    for pid in resolved:
361	        a: dict = {}
362	        for _, _, f in facts:      # merge assignment facts in date order; later non-empty keys win
363	            if f.get("type") == "assignment" and same_text(f.get("position"), pid):
364	                a.update({k: v for k, v in f.items() if v not in (None, "")})
365	        assignments[pid] = a
366	        if a.get("setup_pool_key"):
367	            pool_members[norm_id(a["setup_pool_key"])].append(pid)
368	        if a.get("bonus_plan_key"):
369	            bonus_members[norm_id(a["bonus_plan_key"])].append(pid)
370	    pool_share: dict[str, D] = defaultdict(D)
371	    for key, members in pool_members.items():
372	        amount = number((pools.get(key) or {}).get("amount_eur"))
373	        if amount is None:
374	            note(f"setup pool {key}: amount not found")
375	            continue
376	        weights = {p: D(resolved[p]["q"]) * (number(resolved[p]["material"].get("allocation_weight_g")) or D(0)) for p in members}
377	        for p, share in largest_remainder(amount, weights).items():
378	            pool_share[p] += share
379	        note(f"setup pool {key} {amount} -> {dict(pool_share)}")
380	    bonus_share: dict[str, D] = defaultdict(D)
381	    for key, members in bonus_members.items():
382	        plan = bonus_plans.get(key)
383	        eligible = {p: resolved[p]["q"] * resolved[p]["base"] for p in members if resolved[p]["base"] is not None}
384	        if not plan or not eligible:
385	            note(f"bonus plan {key}: not found or no eligible prices")
386	            continue
387	        credit = marginal_bonus(sum(eligible.values()), plan.get("bands") or [])
388	        for p, share in largest_remainder(credit, eligible).items():
389	            bonus_share[p] += share
390	        note(f"bonus plan {key}: base {sum(eligible.values())} credit {credit}")
391	
392	    pooled: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
393	    for r in resolved.values():
394	        pooled[norm_id(r["material"]["material_number"])] += r["q"]
395	
396	    out_positions, breakdown, total = [], {}, D(0)
397	    for pid, r in resolved.items():
398	        m, q, base = r["material"], r["q"], r["base"]
399	        if base is None or q <= 0:
400	            skipped.append(pid)
401	            continue
402	        mass = (number(m.get("surcharge_mass_g")) or D(0)) / 1000
403	        index = _index_rate(indices.get(norm_id(m.get("price_index_key"))), T) if m.get("price_index_key") else None
404	        if m.get("price_index_key") and index is None:
405	            note(f"{pid}: metal index {m.get('price_index_key')} not found")
406	        mass_surcharge = mass * (index or D(0))
407	        group = latest("condition_group", pid)
408	        scope = clauses.get(norm_id(group.get("group")), "base_only") if group else "base_only"
409	        setup_fact = latest("setup_cost", pid)
410	        setup = (number(setup_fact.get("amount_eur")) or D(0)) if setup_fact else D(0)
411	        setup += pool_share.get(pid, D(0))
412	        a = assignments[pid]
413	        tariff = number((tariffs.get(norm_id(a.get("packaging_key"))) or {}).get("eur_per_carton")) if a.get("packaging_key") else None
414	        carton = integer(m.get("pieces_per_carton"))
415	        packaging = D(ceil(q / carton)) * tariff if tariff is not None and carton else D(0)
416	        bonus = bonus_share.get(pid, D(0))
417	        disc_base = base * (1 - d) if scope in ("base_only", "base_and_surcharge") else base
418	        disc_mass = mass_surcharge * (1 - d) if scope == "base_and_surcharge" else mass_surcharge
419	        unit_price = r2(disc_base + disc_mass + (setup + packaging - bonus) / q)
420	        lead = _lead_time(m, pooled[norm_id(m["material_number"])], commitments.get(norm_id(a.get("delivery_key"))) if a.get("delivery_key") else None)
421	        total += q * unit_price
422	        out_positions.append({
423	            "position": pid, "material_number": m["material_number"], "quantity": q,
424	            "unit_price": float(unit_price), "lead_time_weeks": lead,
425	            "base_unit_price": float(base), "surcharge_per_unit": float(r2(mass_surcharge + setup / q)),
426	            "packaging_per_unit": float(r2(packaging / q)), "rebate_total": float(r2(bonus)),
427	        })
428	        breakdown[pid] = {"scope": scope, "index": index, "mass_surcharge": mass_surcharge, "setup": setup,
429	                          "packaging": packaging, "bonus": bonus, "unit_price": unit_price,
430	                          "filters": {k: m.get(k) for k in ("bore_mm", "stroke_mm", "pressure_bar", "mounting", "certification")}}
431	        note(f"{pid}: {m['material_number']} q={q} base={base} scope={scope} mass={mass_surcharge} setup={setup} "
432	             f"pack={packaging} bonus={bonus} -> {unit_price}, lead {lead}")
433	    answer = {"tender_reference": ctx.tender_reference, "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR",
434	              "discount_percent": float(discount), "positions": out_positions, "total_net": float(r2(total))}
435	    return Result(answer, trace, sorted(set(skipped)), breakdown)
436	
437	
438	def _index_rate(entries, T: datetime) -> D | None:
439	    if not entries:
440	        return None
441	    if isinstance(entries, dict):
442	        entries = [entries]
443	    for e in entries:
444	        start, end = day(e.get("valid_from")), day(e.get("valid_to"))
445	        if (start is None or start <= T.date()) and (end is None or T.date() <= end):
446	            if start or end:
447	                return number(e.get("eur_per_kg"))
448	    return number(entries[-1].get("eur_per_kg"))
449	
450	
451	def _lead_time(m: dict, pooled_qty: int, commitment: dict | None) -> int:
452	    if commitment and norm_id(commitment.get("material")) == norm_id(m["material_number"]):
453	        limit = number(commitment.get("max_total_qty"))
454	        if limit is not None and pooled_qty <= limit:
455	            return integer(commitment.get("weeks")) or 0
456	    stock = number(m.get("unrestricted_stock"))
457	    if stock is not None and pooled_qty <= stock:
458	        return integer(m.get("lead_time_stock_weeks")) or 0
459	    return integer(m.get("lead_time_production_weeks")) or integer(m.get("lead_time_stock_weeks")) or 0

1 """Parsing of raw values as shown on the websites: numbers with locale tags, dates, units, identifiers."""
   2 import re
   3 from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
   4 from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
   5 
   6 ZERO_WIDTH = re.compile(r"[​-‍⁠﻿­]")
   7 
   8 
   9 def clean(text) -> str:
  10     return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", ZERO_WIDTH.sub("", str(text or "")).replace(" ", " ")).strip()
  11 
  12 
  13 def norm_id(text) -> str:
  14     """Identifier for comparisons: no zero-width chars, no spaces, upper case."""
  15     return re.sub(r"\s+", "", clean(text)).upper()
  16 
  17 
  18 def number(raw, locale: str | None = None) -> Decimal | None:
  19     """'4.321,09 (de-DE)' -> 4321.09 ; '512,345 (en-US)' -> 512345 ; '7.85' -> 7.85 ; '5 %' -> 5."""
  20     if raw is None:
  21         return None
  22     if isinstance(raw, (int, float, Decimal)):
  23         return Decimal(str(raw))
  24     text = clean(raw)
  25     tag = re.search(r"\((de-DE|en-US|en-GB|de-AT|de-CH|fr-FR)\)", text)
  26     locale = (tag.group(1) if tag else locale) or ""
  27     text = re.sub(r"\(.*?\)", "", text)
  28     match = re.search(r"-?[\d.,'’ ]*\d", text)
  29     if not match:
  30         return None
  31     digits = match.group(0).replace(" ", "").replace("'", "").replace("’", "")
  32     if locale.startswith("de") or locale.startswith("fr"):
  33         digits = digits.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
  34     elif locale.startswith("en"):
  35         digits = digits.replace(",", "")
  36     elif "," in digits and "." in digits:                      # both: the last one is the decimal separator
  37         if digits.rfind(",") > digits.rfind("."):
  38             digits = digits.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
  39         else:
  40             digits = digits.replace(",", "")
  41     elif "," in digits:                  # only commas: thousands groups ("1,234,567" / "512,345") or a German decimal
  42         parts = digits.split(",")
  43         thousands = len(parts) > 2 or len(parts[-1]) == 3
  44         digits = digits.replace(",", "") if thousands else digits.replace(",", ".")
  45     elif digits.count(".") > 1:          # "1.234.567": German thousands groups
  46         digits = digits.replace(".", "")
  47     try:
  48         return Decimal(digits)
  49     except InvalidOperation:
  50         return None
  51 
  52 
  53 def money_locale(raws) -> str | None:
  54     """The number format of one table of money amounts that carries no locale tag, or None if it cannot be told or
  55     the table contradicts itself. Amounts have at most two decimals, so a separator followed by exactly three digits
  56     groups thousands ('1.234' on a German page is 1234) unless the part before it is 0."""
  57     votes = set()
  58     for raw in raws:
  59         token = re.search(r"\d[\d.,]*\d|\d", re.sub(r"\(.*?\)", "", clean(raw)))
  60         token = token.group(0) if token else ""
  61         seps = [i for i, ch in enumerate(token) if ch in ".,"]
  62         if not seps:
  63             continue
  64         last = token[seps[-1]]
  65         if len({token[i] for i in seps}) > 1:                  # both kinds: the last one is the decimal separator
  66             votes.add("de-DE" if last == "," else "en-US")
  67             continue
  68         head, tail = token[:seps[-1]], token[seps[-1] + 1:]
  69         if len(tail) == 3 and head.lstrip(".,") not in ("0", ""):
  70             votes.add("de-DE" if last == "." else "en-US")     # thousands separator
  71         else:
  72             votes.add("de-DE" if last == "," else "en-US")     # decimal separator
  73     return votes.pop() if len(votes) == 1 else None
  74 
  75 
  76 def integer(raw) -> int | None:
  77     value = number(raw)
  78     return int(value) if value is not None else None
  79 
  80 
  81 def when(raw) -> datetime | None:
  82     """ISO 8601 (with Z/offset or date only) -> aware UTC datetime. Date-only values become 00:00 UTC."""
  83     if raw is None:
  84         return None
  85     if isinstance(raw, datetime):
  86         return raw if raw.tzinfo else raw.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
  87     text = clean(raw)
  88     if not text or text.lower() == "null":
  89         return None
  90     try:
  91         value = datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
  92         return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
  93     except ValueError:
  94         pass
  95     match = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})(?:,?\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?)?", text)
  96     if match:
  97         d, m, y, hh, mm, ss = match.groups()
  98         return datetime(int(y), int(m), int(d), int(hh or 0), int(mm or 0), int(ss or 0), tzinfo=timezone.utc)
  99     return None
 100 
 101 
 102 def day(raw) -> date | None:
 103     value = when(raw)
 104     return value.date() if value else None
 105 
 106 
 107 def same_text(a, b) -> bool:
 108     return clean(a).casefold() == clean(b).casefold()
 109 
 110 
 111 NO_CERT = {"", "NONE", "KEINE", "KEINEGEFORDERT", "OHNE", "OHNEZERTIFIZIERUNG", "NULL", "-", "—", "N/A"}
 112 
 113 
 114 def cert(raw) -> str:
 115     value = norm_id(raw)
 116     return "" if value in NO_CERT else value
 117 
 118 
 119 _NOT_CURRENT = re.compile(r"\b(un|nicht\s*)g[üu]ltig|\binvalid|ersetzt|superseded|veraltet|obsolet|zur[üu]ckgezogen|"
 120                           r"withdrawn|archiv|entwurf|draft|vorschau|preview|outdated|replaced", re.I)
 121 _CURRENT = re.compile(r"(?<![a-zäöü])(g[üu]ltig|aktuell|current|valid|freigegeben|maßgeblich|massgeblich|in kraft)\b", re.I)
 122 
 123 
 124 def revision_is_current(revision: dict) -> bool:
 125     """A revision counts as current only if it is marked so: an explicit is_current wins; otherwise the status text
 126     must say current/valid and must not say invalid/superseded/draft (substring tricks like 'ungültig' do not count)."""
 127     flag = revision.get("is_current")
 128     if flag is False:
 129         return False
 130     status = clean(revision.get("status_text"))
 131     if status and _NOT_CURRENT.search(status):
 132         return False
 133     return flag is True or bool(status and _CURRENT.search(status))
"""Files the model chose on a website: download links/buttons, ZIP archives, PDF, XLSX, DOCX, CSV/TXT, HTML documents.

Only what the model selected is read: a ZIP is first listed, then the member the model asks for is read. Session
cookies of the site are used; size limits keep the run safe; a login page instead of a file is reported as such.
"""
import asyncio
import io
import re
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse

from playwright.async_api import Error as PlaywrightError

MAX_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024

MAX_MEMBERS = 300


@dataclass
class Document:
    source: str                 # URL (and !member) the content came from
    name: str = ""
    mime: str = ""
    text: str = ""
    members: list | None = None  # for archives without member: [(name, size)]

        if self.members is not None:

        return f"document {self.name or self.source} ({self.mime or 'unknown type'}, {len(self.text)} characters of text)"


async def read_document(site, ref: str | None = None, url: str | None = None, member: str | None = None) -> Document:
    """Fetch the file behind a link/button (ref) or an observed address (url) and turn it into text."""
    try:
        data, name, mime, source = await _fetch(site, ref, url)
    except _Failure as failure:

class _Failure(Exception):
    pass


async def _fetch(site, ref, url) -> tuple[bytes, str, str, str]:
    if ref:
        _, element = await site._element(ref)
        href = await element.get_attribute("href")
        if href and not href.startswith(("#", "javascript:")):
            url = site.absolute(href)
        else:   # a button that starts a download
            try:
                async with site.page.expect_download(timeout=15000) as info:
                    await element.click(timeout=5000)
                download = await info.value
                path = await download.path()
                data = open(path, "rb").read() if path else b""
                return _limit(data), download.suggested_filename, _guess_mime(download.suggested_filename), download.url
            except PlaywrightError as error:
                raise _Failure(f"clicking it did not start a download ({str(error).splitlines()[0][:120]})")
    if not url:
        raise _Failure("give the ref of a download link/button or an address you saw")
    url = site.absolute(url)
    if urlparse(url).netloc != site.origin:
        raise _Failure("only files of this website can be read")
    if not site.was_seen(url):
        raise _Failure("this address was not offered on any page you saw")
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            response = await site.context.request.get(url, timeout=30000)
        except PlaywrightError as error:
            if attempt == 2:
                raise _Failure(f"download failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:120]}")
            await asyncio.sleep(1 + attempt)
            continue

# 11 · MVP-Status (Stand 2026-10-10, nachmittags)

## Was funktioniert (lokal gegen die Scouting-Sites gemessen)

| Phase | Ergebnis | Zeit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Login, Cookie-Walls, Gates, Overlays auf allen 4 Sites | automatisch über `guards.js` | ~4 s |
| Brief-Analyse (Qwen ohne Thinking, JSON) | Referenz, Stichtag, Firma, USt-Id, Site-Rollen, autorisierte Absender korrekt | ~13 s |
| Tender (Positionen + 17 Q&A über 6 Seiten) | vollständig, Rückzug erkannt | ~65 s |
| Spezifikation (Freigabeformular, aktuelle Revision per Tooltip, 5 Anforderungen) | vollständig | ~60 s |
| Mail (Inbox 6 Seiten + Archiv 4 Seiten, 18 Nachrichten) | alle Themen gefunden, Köder gefiltert | ~190 s |
| ERP (eine Mission je benötigter Kataloggruppe, parallel in Tabs) | alle Materialien inkl. Staffeln/Bestand/Status | ~150–235 s |
| Regeln/Pricing (`resolve.py`) | **100/100 gegen `dev/oracle/public-1.json`** (`dev/eval/score.py`) | < 1 s |
| Abgabe (10 Schritte Konfigurator, TAN aus Mail, Summary-Check, `confirm`) | durchgelaufen bis „verbindlich abgeben“ (Dry-Run) | ~210 s |

Gesamt lokal: Evidenz ≈ 4 min + Abgabe ≈ 3,5 min ≈ **8 min**; Kosten ≈ 1,2 M Input-Tokens ≈ **$0,19** pro Lauf.

Wichtig: Das Oracle ist **unser** Soll und noch nicht durch einen Sandbox-Test-Run bestätigt (siehe `dev/README.md`).

## Wichtige Erkenntnisse aus den Läufen (bereits umgesetzt)

# 04 · Geschäftsregeln & Rechenweg (Spezifikation für `rules/`)

Quelle: Brief (Regeln 1–8 + „Additional rules“), Challenge-Seite (Regeln 01–29), Mail-Prosa aus public-1, Formular-
Hinweise im Konfigurator. Die Regeln gelten laut Plattform **identisch für public und privat** → wir implementieren
sie deterministisch. Die *Werte* (Keys, Prozente, Prosa-Varianten) kommen zur Laufzeit von den Sites.

Punkte mit ⚠️ sind Interpretationen, die per Test-Run (Punkte je Feld) bestätigt werden müssen.

## Notation

`q_p` finale Stückzahl der Position p · `d` Order-Rabatt (Bruch, z. B. 0.05) · `r2(x)` = `x.quantize(Decimal("0.01"),
ROUND_HALF_UP)` · alle Werte `Decimal`, nie `float`. Stichtag `T` = Szenariodatum aus Brief (UTC).

## A. Auswahl der gültigen Records („Authority and time“)

Für jeden Schlüssel (Rabatt, Konditionsregeln, Technikfreigabe, Verpackungstarif, Terminfreigabe, Devisenfixing,
Rüstpool, Projektbonus, Preisindex):
1. Nur Records mit **exakt** der Tender-Referenz (String-Gleichheit nach Normalisierung von Zero-Width/Whitespace;
   `…-A` ≠ Referenz).
2. Nur **autorisierte Absender**: Localpart laut Brief + **Bieter-Mailbox-Domain** (aus Webmail-Identität bzw.
   Brief). Paare aus Brief: Technikfreigabe/technik, Verpackungstarife/logistik, Terminfreigabe/logistik,
   Devisenfixing/finanzen, Rüstpools/kalkulation, Projektbonus/finanzen, Konditionsregeln/kalkulation,
   Preisindizes/kalkulation, Rabatt/leitung (Direktor). ⚠️ Privat können Localparts anders heißen → immer aus dem
   **Brief des Runs** parsen, nicht hardcoden.
3. Nur Records mit Datum **≤ T** (zukunftsdatiert = ungültig). Entwürfe/„nicht versandt“/Vorschau zählen nie.
4. **Neuester** Record gewinnt (pro Schlüssel bzw. pro Eintrag „je Schlüssel“). Ein neuerer Record ersetzt den älteren
   auch dann, wenn seine Bedingung scheitert („a failed quantity condition does not revive it“).

## B. Menge (Regeln 1, 13, 17)

1. Start: Menge + Einheit aus LV/Positionsübersicht.
2. Q&A-Mengenänderungen je Position nach **Datum** (nicht Nummer) sortieren; zurückgezogene Antworten
   („zurückziehen“, „ersatzlos zurückgezogen“, Referenz per Nummer) entfernen; jüngste verbleibende gilt, sonst LV.
3. Einheit `Satz` (o. ä.): × „Stück je Satz“ aus der **maßgeblichen** Spezifikationsrevision → `q_p` in Stück.
4. `q_p` ist die Bid-Menge. Kartonrundung ändert `q_p` nie.

## C. Anforderung & Material (Regeln 2, 3, 14, 20)

1. Spezifikationsrevision mit Status „gültig/aktuell“ (marked current) wählen — nicht die zuerst angezeigte, nicht nach
   Datum raten.
2. Anforderung der Position (Referenz aus LV, z. B. `A-2`) aus dieser Revision lesen: Bohrung, Hub, Druck,
   Befestigung, Zertifizierung, Kataloggruppe, ggf. „nutzbarer Weg“ + Endreserve-Key, ggf. Stück je Satz.
3. Technische Nachträge aus Q&A, die **genau diese Revision und Anforderung** nennen: je Merkmal jüngster datierter
   Nachtrag ersetzt nur dieses Merkmal.
4. „Nutzbarer Weg“: `Hub_ERP = Hub_nach_Nachträgen + 2 × Endreserve(Key, Revision)` aus Technikfreigabe.
5. ERP: Kataloggruppe suchen (≤ 20 Treffer), Kandidaten mit **exakt** gleichen Bohrung, Hub, Druck, Befestigung,
   Zertifizierung („keine gefordert“ ≙ ohne Zertifizierung ⚠️) und Status **aktiv/freigegeben** (gesperrt zählt nicht).
6. Kein passendes aktives Material für **irgendeine** Position ⇒ `decision = no_bid`, `positions = []`,
   `total_net = 0`, Rabatt: bedingte Freigabe ⇒ 0 %. ⚠️ Mehrere passende aktive Materialien: sollte nicht vorkommen →
   loggen, das mit Bestand/gültiger Kondition wählen.

## D. Basispreis (Regeln 4, 22)

1. Konditionssatz des Materials, dessen Gültigkeit `T` enthält (beide Enden inklusive; Zeitzone der Anzeige beachten).
2. Staffel: größte „ab Menge“ ≤ `q_p` (**pro Position**, nicht pro Material-Summe).
3. Preis je Preiseinheit → je Stück: `price / price_unit_qty` (z. B. „100 ST“). Zahlenformat laut Tag!
4. Währung ≠ EUR: × Kurs „EUR je Währungseinheit“ aus Devisenfixing (FX-Key aus Kondition).
5. `base_p = r2(price_per_piece × fx)` — dieser gerundete EUR-Basispreis wird überall weiterverwendet
   (Rabattschwelle, Bonusbasis, Endpreis). ⚠️ Bei EUR ebenfalls `r2` (Preiseinheit 100 kann 3+ Nachkommastellen
   erzeugen).

## E. Rabatt (Regeln 5, 16)

1. Neueste Direktor-Mail (≤ T, exakte Referenz, `leitung@<bieterdomain>`), die einen Rabatt **genehmigt**.
   „Angebotsprüfung“ o. ä. ohne Genehmigung zählt nicht als Freigabe ⚠️ (zählt sie als „neueste“? Nein — nur
   Freigaben werden verglichen).
2. Bedingte Freigabe („sofern unrabattierter Nettoauftragswert mindestens X“): `V = r2(Σ q_p × base_p)` (ohne
   Zuschläge, Rüstkosten, Verpackung). `V ≥ X` ⇒ Prozentsatz, sonst **0 %** (keine ältere Freigabe reaktivieren).
3. `discount_percent` im Answer = dieser Order-Prozentsatz (auch wenn einzelne Positionen per Klausel nicht rabattiert
   werden). Bei `no_bid` mit bedingter Freigabe: 0.

## F. Konditionsgruppen (Regel 12)

Q&A kann Position → Konditionsgruppe zuordnen; Prosa in neuester `Konditionsregeln`-Mail (kalkulation@) je Gruppe:
- `base_only` (Default ohne Gruppe): Rabatt nur auf Basispreis.
- `base_and_surcharge`: Rabatt auf Basispreis + gewichtsabhängigen Materialzuschlag.
- `none` (Festpreis): kein Rabatt.
Rüstkosten (normal + Pool), Verpackung und Bonus werden **nie** rabattiert. Gruppe gilt je Position (auch wenn zwei
Positionen dasselbe Material haben).

def _limit(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise _Failure(f"file too large ({len(data)} bytes)")
    return data


def _guess_mime(name: str) -> str:
    ext = name.lower().rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in name else ""
    return {"zip": "application/zip", "pdf": "application/pdf", "csv": "text/csv", "txt": "text/plain",
            "html": "text/html", "htm": "text/html", "json": "application/json", "xml": "text/xml",
            "xlsx": XLSX_MIME, "docx": DOCX_MIME}.get(ext, "")


def parse(data: bytes, name: str, mime: str, source: str, member: str | None = None) -> Document:
    kind = _kind(data, name, mime)
    if kind == "zip":
        try:
            archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
            return Document(source, name, mime, error="the file is not a readable ZIP archive")
        infos = [i for i in archive.infolist() if not i.is_dir()][:MAX_MEMBERS]
        if not member:
            return Document(source, name, mime, members=[(_member_name(i), i.file_size) for i in infos])
        wanted = next((i for i in infos if _member_name(i) == member or i.filename == member), None) or \
                 next((i for i in infos if member.lower() in _member_name(i).lower()), None)
        if wanted is None:
            return Document(source, name, mime, error=f"no file {member!r} in the archive; files: "
                            + ", ".join(_member_name(i) for i in infos[:40]))
        if wanted.file_size > MAX_MEMBER_BYTES:
            return Document(source, name, mime, error=f"{member} is too large ({wanted.file_size} bytes)")
        inner = archive.read(wanted)
        doc = parse(inner, _member_name(wanted), _guess_mime(_member_name(wanted)), f"{source}!{_member_name(wanted)}")
        return doc
    if kind == "pdf":
        return Document(source, name, mime or "application/pdf", text=_pdf_text(data))
    if kind == "xlsx":
        return Document(source, name, mime or XLSX_MIME, text=_xlsx_text(data))
    if kind == "docx":
        return Document(source, name, mime or DOCX_MIME, text=_docx_text(data))
    text = _decode(data)
    if kind == "html":
        if re.search(r'<input[^>]+type=["\']?password', text, re.I):
            return Document(source, name, mime, error="got a login page instead of the file (session expired?)")
        text = _html_text(text)
    return Document(source, name, mime or "text/plain", text=text)


def _member_name(info: zipfile.ZipInfo) -> str:
    """Archive names are often CP437-decoded UTF-8 (umlauts): repair, and never use them as paths."""
    raw = info.filename
    if not info.flag_bits & 0x800:
        try:
            raw = raw.encode("cp437").decode("utf-8")
        except (UnicodeEncodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            pass
    return raw.replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1] or raw


def _kind(data: bytes, name: str, mime: str) -> str:
    if data[:4] == b"PK\x03\x04" or "zip" in mime or "officedocument" in mime:
        return _office_kind(data) or "zip"   # spreadsheets and Word files are ZIP containers: read their content
    if data[:5] == b"%PDF-" or "pdf" in mime:
        return "pdf"
    head = data[:600].lower()
    if "html" in mime or b"<html" in head or b"<!doctype html" in head:
        return "html"
    return "text"


def _decode(data: bytes) -> str:
    for encoding in ("utf-8-sig", "cp1252", "latin-1"):
        try:
            return data.decode(encoding)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    return data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")


def _html_text(markup: str) -> str:
    import html as html_lib
    markup = re.sub(r"<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\1>", " ", markup, flags=re.S | re.I)
    markup = re.sub(r'<[^>]*aria-hidden="true"[^>]*>.*?</[^>]+>', " ", markup, flags=re.S)
    markup = re.sub(r"<(br|/p|/div|/tr|/li|/h\d)[^>]*>", "\n", markup, flags=re.I)
    text = html_lib.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", markup))
    text = re.sub(r"[​-‍⁠﻿­]", "", text)
    return re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n", text)).strip()


def _pdf_text(data: bytes) -> str:
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
    except ImportError:
        return "(PDF text extraction is not available; use inspect_visual on the viewer)"
    try:
        reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data))
        pages = [page.extract_text() or "" for page in reader.pages[:60]]
    except Exception as error:   # malformed PDFs
        return f"(PDF could not be read: {type(error).__name__})"
    text = "\n\n".join(f"--- page {i + 1} ---\n{t}" for i, t in enumerate(pages))
    return text if text.strip() else "(the PDF has no text layer; it is probably scanned: use inspect_visual)"


XLSX_MIME = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
DOCX_MIME = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"


def _office_kind(data: bytes) -> str | None:
    try:
        names = set(zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)).namelist())
    except zipfile.BadZipFile:
        return None
    return "xlsx" if "xl/workbook.xml" in names else "docx" if "word/document.xml" in names else None


def _xlsx_text(data: bytes) -> str:
    """Every sheet as rows of cells (the values the file shows, not formulas)."""
    try:
        from openpyxl import load_workbook
        book = load_workbook(io.BytesIO(data), read_only=True, data_only=True)
    except Exception as error:   # missing library or malformed file
        return f"(spreadsheet could not be read: {type(error).__name__})"
    parts = []
    for sheet in book.worksheets[:20]:
        rows = []
        for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True, max_row=3000):
            cells = ["" if v is None else str(v) for v in row]
            while cells and not cells[-1]:
                cells.pop()
            if cells:
                rows.append(" | ".join(cells))
        parts.append(f"## sheet {sheet.title}\n" + "\n".join(rows))
    return "\n\n".join(parts) or "(the spreadsheet is empty)"


def _docx_text(data: bytes) -> str:
    """Paragraphs as lines, table rows as 'cell | cell' (only the document body, no tracked deletions)."""
    import html as html_lib
    try:
        xml = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)).read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, KeyError) as error:
        return f"(Word document could not be read: {type(error).__name__})"
    xml = re.sub(r"<w:del\b.*?</w:del>", "", xml, flags=re.S)
    xml = re.sub(r"<w:tc\b.*?</w:tc>", lambda cell: cell.group(0).replace("</w:p>", " "), xml, flags=re.S)
    xml = re.sub(r"</w:tc>", " | ", xml)
    xml = re.sub(r"</w:p>|</w:tr>|<w:br\s*/>", "\n", xml)
    text = html_lib.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", xml))
    lines = [re.sub(r"\s*\|\s*$", "", re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", line)).strip() for line in text.splitlines()]
    return "\n".join(re.sub(r"(\s*\|\s*)+", " | ", line) for line in lines if line.strip(" |"))
